plugins.name: cc-statusline
plugins.description: 4-line ANSI dashboard statusline for Claude Code showing environment and reasoning effort, context window and subscription rate limits, session cost, and git and worktree status

plugins.name: cmux-plugin
plugins.description: Integrates Claude Code with cmux — the native macOS terminal built for AI coding agents. Provides automatic workspace naming, session notifications, sidebar progress reporting, browser split automation, and Superpowers plugin awareness.

plugins.name: cowork-backup
plugins.description: Cross-platform Cowork session backup & restore. Detects your OS and installs the appropriate backup scripts and scheduler (LaunchAgent on macOS, systemd on Linux, Task Scheduler on Windows). One-command interactive restore.

plugins.name: claude-speak
plugins.description: Opt-in voice output for Claude Code — off by default in every session, condenses long or table-heavy replies for the ear, and interrupts instantly with !shutup
